text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. I was just watching the others
train.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Each and every one of the people here
has a goal—a dream they're working
toward. That's why
they're putting forth
their very best effort.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
We too have our own dreams to chase,
so we
can't afford to give anything less
than our best,
can we?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Yeah.
Well, should we get
started?
